facts.en: Completed a statistics diploma at Fictional Reed College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构芦苇学院完成统计文凭课程。

facts.en: Programme records assistant at Fictional Pebble Learning from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构卵石学习机构任项目记录助理。

facts.en: Maintained participant IDs, attendance sheets and session feedback logs.
facts.zh: 维护参与者编号、出席表及活动反馈日志。

facts.en: Supported a 2025 workshop series consisting of an introduction and a follow-up session.
facts.zh: 支持 2025 年由入门场和跟进场组成的工作坊系列。

facts.en: The introduction had 18 attendees and the follow-up had 15 attendees; 12 people attended both.
facts.zh: 入门场有 18 人出席，跟进场有 15 人出席；12 人两场均出席。

facts.en: The confirmed series total was 33 attendances across 21 distinct people, not 33 unique participants.
facts.zh: 该系列确认合计为 33 人次，涉及 21 名不同人士，并非 33 名独立参与者。

facts.en: Personally reconciled the shared participant IDs; the programme lead confirmed the matching rules.
facts.zh: 个人核对共享参与者编号；匹配规则由项目负责人确认。

facts.en: Prepared weekly summaries that separated attendances from unique participant counts.
facts.zh: 准备区分出席人次与独立参与者数量的每周摘要。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet deduplication checks, filters and pivot tables.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格去重检查、筛选及数据透视表。

facts.en: Co-created a feedback export checklist with a trainer in 2025-10.
facts.zh: 2025-10 与培训师共同制作反馈导出核对表。

facts.en: Checked 26 feedback rows and flagged 3 duplicated submissions for review; did not infer learning effectiveness.
facts.zh: 检查 26 条反馈记录并标记 3 条重复提交供审核；未推断学习效果。

facts.en: Drafted an automated registration dashboard in 2026-02; only a static mockup was produced.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草自动报名仪表板；仅制作静态模型。

facts.en: A 2022 class project summarized a fictional attendance dataset; it was not paid work.
facts.zh: 2022 年课堂项目总结虚构出席数据集；非有薪工作。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Seed Club during 2024-03 to 2024-07 alongside employment.
facts.zh: 2024-03 至 2024-07 工作同期在虚构种子社做志愿者。

facts.en: Labelled seed packets for that club; these were unrelated to the learning cohort.
facts.zh: 为该社团标注种子袋；与学习参与者群体无关。

facts.en: Recorded corrections in a dated change log.
facts.zh: 在带日期的变更日志中记录修正。

facts.en: Enjoys making miniature gardens.
facts.zh: 爱好制作微型花园。

facts.en: Created a personal reading tracker in 2023 with no claimed programme effect.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人阅读跟踪表，不声称有项目影响。

facts.en: A draft summary describes 33 people served; the deduplicated record establishes 21 distinct people.
facts.zh: 摘要草稿写服务 33 人；去重记录确认是 21 名不同人士。

facts.en: No SQL database administration or causal evaluation work is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录 SQL 数据库管理或因果评估工作。
